records.title: Privacy-preserving root identity record
records.exact_text: Pseudonymous identifier, verified public signing keys, controlled recovery, disputes and appeals; never publish baseline face embeddings, biometric samples, residential data or secret keys.

records.title: Verified Identity Vault
records.exact_text: Catalog legitimately verified books, publications, media, interviews, identity records and permissioned works with source citations, source-side verification and owner review.

records.title: Name-Twin Noise
records.exact_text: Separate similarly named people by verifiable identity attributes; exclude from a given person's matching queue without deleting the unrelated person's content.

records.title: Fake AI / impersonation triage
records.exact_text: Flag suspected synthetic media, cloned voices, unauthorized endorsements and spoof profiles. Missing or invalid provenance alone never establishes deepfake or illegality.

records.title: Reputation harm triage
records.exact_text: Flag suspected doxxing, privacy violations, proven false statements and obsolete exposures; route criticism, opinion and lawful journalism to a non-removal evidence review.

records.title: Distinguish subject, creator, rights holder
records.exact_text: Person depicted, photographer or creator, copyright holder, licensee and consenting subject are distinct roles; a hash or registration does not automatically establish ownership or rights.

records.title: SHA-256 exact-byte fingerprint
records.exact_text: Generate SHA-256 on source bytes; a changed file hash shows byte difference, not authorship, consent or legal ownership. Cropping/re-encoding changes bytes.
records.provenance: Assistant-derived technical architecture based on user-supplied project

records.title: Ed25519 signatures and signed statements
records.exact_text: Verify whether a claim was signed by a key linked to a reviewed credential. Key ownership and identity binding require separate verification.
records.provenance: Assistant-derived technical architecture based on user-supplied project

records.title: C2PA Content Credentials
records.exact_text: Attach and verify provenance manifests for assets when supported by capture or publishing tooling. Provenance does not establish that depicted statements are factually true.
records.provenance: Assistant-derived technical architecture based on user-supplied project

records.title: Merkle evidence journal
records.exact_text: Create append-only verifiable event commitments and inclusion receipts; Merkle inclusion proves recorded consistency, not truth, original authorship or legal entitlement.
records.provenance: Assistant-derived technical architecture based on user-supplied project

records.title: Robust matching and perceptual signatures
records.exact_text: For consented supplied media, use perceptual fingerprints to propose matches across crops and re-encoding; confidence thresholds, false positives and human review required.
records.provenance: Assistant-derived technical architecture based on user-supplied project

records.title: Watermark / soft-binding recovery
records.exact_text: Optional robust watermark plus lookup service may help recover detached manifests. No watermark survives all edits and no missing mark establishes unauthorized use.

records.title: Hardware-attested capture optional
records.exact_text: Use trusted capture-chain evidence when hardware/platform support exists. A signature can authenticate a device assertion, but not every scene fact or the subject's consent.

records.title: Verifiable identities and issuer trust
records.exact_text: Separate issuer-signed identity credentials from subject claims; provide revocation, key rotation, appeals, and multiple trusted issuers rather than one unchallengeable registry.
records.provenance: Assistant-derived technical architecture based on user-supplied project

records.title: Encryption envelope / ML-KEM
records.exact_text: Optional authenticated encryption AES-256-GCM with properly managed keys; ML-KEM may be used in a hybrid key-establishment design. Encryption protects controlled assets, not arbitrary copied web files.
records.provenance: Assistant-derived technical architecture based on user-supplied project

records.title: Explicit purpose-scoped authorization
records.exact_text: Signed, timestamped grant names the subject, media, use, license scope, platform, duration, and jurisdiction. Silence or an absent signature is not equivalent to proof of refusal.
records.provenance: Assistant-derived technical architecture based on user-supplied project

records.title: Revocation with effect and audit
records.exact_text: Record withdrawal and notify participating systems; do not claim that revocation retroactively erases third-party copies or overrides valid competing legal rights.

records.title: Permitted discovery and monitoring
records.exact_text: Query public sources and authorized platform APIs within terms and law, deduplicate matches and track detected URL snapshots. No unauthorized penetration of hidden systems.

records.title: Forensics risk review
records.exact_text: Combine provenance validation, model-based anomaly signals and source comparison. Display uncertainty and obtain review before asserting fraud or synthetic generation.

records.title: Immutable evidence and SHA-256 audit
records.exact_text: Record discovery URL, date, source, lawful screenshot, original-vs-copy comparison, cryptographic digest, reviewer, action, responses and reversals; keep sensitive evidence private.

records.title: Dispute and appeal procedure
records.exact_text: Allow conflicting ownership and consent claims, public-interest exceptions, documented appeals and reinstatement; never auto-erase unrelated people's legitimate content.

records.title: Six ONE Federation deterministic workers
records.exact_text: Leonardo orchestrates; Donatello proposes classification; Raphael checks SHA-256; Michelangelo relates exact hashes; DaVinci audits counts; AncientSpecialists preserves review tiers. These are deterministic processes, not provisioned independent LLM agents.
